datasets.title: Registers to extract
datasets.description: Convictions = the prosecutions/fines register. Notices = Improvement/Prohibition enforcement notices. Both are independent HSE registers with different fields and are pulled newest-first.

fetchBreachDetail.title: Fetch per-breach legislation detail
fetchBreachDetail.description: When enabled (default), fetches each breach's own page (or, for notices, the breach list) for the court, Act/Regulation section, hearing date and per-breach fine. Disable for a faster run with only the case/notice-level summary fields.

maxItemsPerDataset.title: Max records per register
maxItemsPerDataset.description: Hard cap on how many records to return per selected register this run (applied independently to Convictions and Notices, both sorted newest-first).

onlyNew.title: Delta mode - only new records since last run
onlyNew.description: When enabled, persists seen record ids between runs (in this actor's own key-value store) and returns only records not seen in a prior run. Pagination stops as soon as it reaches already-seen records, so a scheduled daily/hourly run resolves in seconds instead of walking the whole register. Recommended for recurring monitoring; leave off for a full one-off extraction.

dateRange.title: Filter by recency (source date field)
dateRange.description: Optionally restrict results to records whose own date field (Offence Date for convictions, served-on date for notices) falls within this window. Independent of onlyNew - note that Offence Date can lag real publication by months, so onlyNew is the more reliable 'what's new' signal; use this filter when you specifically need the source's own date semantics.
